I answered Dana in a #north-team thread. The only deadline anyone has posted for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is 21 December, which Marcus shared in that channel on 14 October. Nothing in the channel since then changes it.

I told her I can't confirm that 21 December is the final agreed date, and suggested she check with Marcus before putting it in the tracker as settled. Dana is in #north-team, so she can already see his message, and a signing date isn't a finance figure.
